title: Create UNSC version
description: A modpack focusing on create made by and for the UN Security Cats
body:
This Modpack is made by the UN Security Cats represented by me, derBarbar.

Its a Neoforge based project focusing on the Create mod with alot of perfomance mods including Bad Optimisation and Sodium but also some Ressouce Packs to make the pack more Create themed. Shaders are also ready to use if your PC can handle it.

The modpack has no Worldgen mods and only uses Create: Structures Arise to add a few new structures to the world to not overwhlem new modded players, the items and blocks are already more than enough.

The most notable mod is the Create mod with some longexisting addons like The Factory Must Grow, Dream and Desires, Big Cannons and Stuff And Additions, but also the famous newcomer Aeronautics, Guardian Shooter and Solarpunk.

I hope you enjoy this modpack. If you find any problems send a mail to derbarbar123@gmail.com
